Name: Public
Description: Information intended for or harmless if publicly disclosed (e.g. product descriptions, country codes, LEI).

Name: Internal
Description: Business information for internal use, with limited impact if disclosed (e.g. internal codes, source identifiers).

Name: Confidential
Description: Commercially sensitive information restricted to roles with a business need (e.g. prices, bank account numbers of companies, contract terms).

Name: Personal data
Description: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (GDPR Art. 4(1); personal information under CCPA/CPRA).

Name: Sensitive personal data
Description: Special categories of personal data (GDPR Art. 9), data on criminal convictions (Art. 10), and sensitive personal information under CCPA/CPRA (e.g. government identifiers, health, precise geolocation).

Name: Protected health information
Description: Individually identifiable health information held by a HIPAA covered entity or business associate (45 CFR 160.103). Used by the pharma extension.
